digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato (verb fuka)

teaser.en: Named 'to smoke up', because its flowers seem to rise from the ground all at once, like smoke.
teaser.sw: Unaitwa 'kufuka', kwa sababu maua yake huonekana kuchipuka ardhini yote kwa mara moja, kama moshi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni 'kufuka', kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonekana dza ganatuluka photsi phamwenga gosi, dza mosi unavyofuka.

summary.en: Fuka is a soft, creeping herb of the mint family, a relative of mvuga. Its name compares the sudden flush of its small flowers to smoke rising.
summary.sw: Fuka ni mmea mdogo laini unaotambaa wa familia ya minanaa, ndugu wa mvuga. Jina lake linalinganisha kuchanua kwa ghafla kwa maua yake madogo na moshi unaopanda.
summary.dg: *Fuka* ni mmea laini unaoambala photsi, wa jamii ya *mint*, ndugu wa *mvuga*. Dzinare rinaonyesa kukala maruwage madide, ganayozuka phamwenga gosi, ni dza mosi unaofuka.

about.en: Fuka is a weak-stemmed, sprawling herb that creeps over the ground. *Flaccidus* means 'limp', a fair description of its stems. Like most of the mint family it has square stems and leaves in opposite pairs, and the leaves are faintly aromatic when crushed. Its small two-lipped flowers, pale blue to mauve, are borne on slender upright spikes. Digo people recognise it by the look of its leaves.
about.sw: Fuka ni mmea mdogo wenye mashina dhaifu unaotanda na kutambaa ardhini. *Flaccidus* maana yake 'legevu', maelezo yanayofaa mashina yake. Kama mimea mingi ya familia ya minanaa, una mashina ya pembe nne na majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na majani hutoa harufu hafifu yakipondwa. Maua yake madogo yenye midomo miwili, ya buluu hafifu hadi zambarau hafifu, huota kwenye masuke membamba yaliyosimama. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Fuka* ni mmea laini wenye mihi isiyo na nguvu, unaotandazika na kuambala photsi. *Flaccidus* rina mana ya 'chisicho na nguvu', na neno hiri rinafwaha mihiye. Dza mimea minji ya jamii ya *mint*, mihiye ina pembe nne, na makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalolana; makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu nono chidide. Maruwage madide, genye miromo miiri, ni ga samawati ngushu-ngushu hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, na ganamera dzulu ya milita myembamba inayoima. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: It grows as a ground creeper in the herb layer of bush and woodland, often in shade or among rocks.
where.sw: Hukua kama mmea unaotambaa ardhini katika tabaka la mimea midogo vichakani na misituni, mara nyingi kivulini au katikati ya miamba.
where.dg: Unamera photsi dza mmea unaoambala, kahi ya mimea midide ya weruni na ya matsaka ga mihi, mara nyinji phatu phenye chivuri-vuri au kahi ya mawe.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'to smoke up': the flowers appear so quickly that they seem to rise like smoke. Mgombato glosses the verb *fuka* as 'to rise up (of smoke), to evaporate'. Pakia lists *fuka* among the ground creepers that Digo people class as *nyasi*, the soft herbaceous layer.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kama 'kufuka': maua hutokea haraka sana hivi kwamba huonekana kupanda kama moshi. Mgombato inaeleza kitenzi *fuka* kama 'kupanda juu (moshi), kuvukiza'. Pakia anaorodhesha *fuka* miongoni mwa mimea inayotambaa ardhini ambayo Wadigo huiweka katika *nyasi*, tabaka la mimea laini.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'kufuka': maruwa ganazuka upesi sana hata ganaonekana dza mosi unaofuka. Mgombato inaandika kukala *fuka* rina mana ya mosi kuambuka dzulu, au madzi kumala kpwa dzoho. Pakia anaika *fuka* kahi ya mimea inayoambala photsi ambayo Adigo anaiika kahi ya *nyasi*, mimea laini ya photsi.

names.en: Digo: *fuka*, 'to smoke up'. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no English or Swahili name. Scientists call it *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Its relative *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* is the medicinal *mvuga*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *fuka*, 'kufuka'. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Wanasayansi huuita *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Ndugu yake *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* ni *mvuga*, mmea wa dawa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *fuka*, 'kufuka'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kaandika dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Nduguye *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* ni *mvuga*, unaohumirwa dza dawa.

reason.en: Mvuga, another Plectranthus, used in medicine
reason.sw: Mvuga, Plectranthus mwingine, unaotumika kama dawa

reason.en: African basil, an aromatic plant of the same mint family
reason.sw: Mrihani, mmea wenye harufu nzuri wa familia ileile ya mnanaa
reason.dg: *Chirahani*, mmea wenye arufu nono wa jamii iyo ya *mint*

reason.sw: Kivumbasi, mmea mwingine wa familia ya minanaa

reason.en: Another ground creeper that Pakia groups with nyasi
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotambaa ardhini ambao Pakia anauweka katika nyasi
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaoambala photsi ambao Pakia anauika kahi ya *nyasi*
